# dayloop v0.12.0-rc9 — Day Complete artwork fix

This prerelease corrects the placement of the supplied `Day-Complete.png` graphic.

## What changed since rc8

- Moved `Day-Complete.png` from the small Perfect Day card to the full-screen `DAY COMPLETE` End Day splash.
- Fits the artwork across the splash and anchors its illustrated region to the right edge.
- Keeps the results heading and task summary in a protected dark region on the left.
- Preserves the animated white transition slash above the background artwork.

## What to check

- Tap END DAY and confirm the supplied graphic appears behind the full-screen `DAY COMPLETE` results.
- Confirm the illustrated stars and character remain visible on the right.
- Confirm the heading and task summary remain readable on the left.
- Confirm Settings reports `Dayloop v0.12.0-rc9`.

## Candidate APK notes

- This APK is **not production-signed**. It uses Android's standard debug signing key for hands-on testing.
- Its application id is `com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`, so it can be installed alongside the production Dayloop app.
- Version: `0.12.0-rc9` (`versionCode 22`).

_Fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA._
